description: This file defines a React component for the Actions page in a defect management system. It includes form handling, API interactions, and UI rendering for listing, creating, and managing corrective actions related to defects.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of actions from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new action via the API and refreshes the list.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes an existing action by ID via the API and refreshes the list.
